cards.title: The US in Brief: California's voter-fraud showdown
cards.preview: The Justice Department demands California election records despite offering little evidence for its non-citizen voting claims. The issue also follows the Alaska ballot controversy and surprisingly competitive Democratic campaigns in Kansas and Iowa.
cards.durationBasis: Conservative planning allowance; actual duration not independently verified

cards.title: The Americans changing politics for the better
cards.preview: The newsletter argues that Hispanic and Asian swing voters are pushing American politics towards practical economic concerns rather than party loyalty. It contrasts that dynamism with a British budget criticised for postponing difficult reforms.
cards.durationBasis: Conservative planning allowance; actual duration not independently verified

cards.title: The US in Brief: A fishy campaign in Alaska
cards.preview: Allegations that Democratic allies recruited a namesake challenger shake Alaska’s Senate race; Mary Peltola’s campaign denies involvement. The roundup also covers the Fed holding rates steady and fiercely contested elections in Ohio.
cards.durationBasis: Conservative planning allowance; actual duration not independently verified

cards.title: The Insider: Will the midterms make the world more dangerous?
cards.preview: This discussion asks how Trump might react abroad if Republicans lose control of Congress. The agenda spans Iran and Israel, dealings with China and Russia, Latin America and the president’s search for a legacy.
cards.durationBasis: 45 minutes explicitly stated for this episode

cards.title: The US in Brief: Crude politics in Texas
cards.preview: Trump campaigns for Ken Paxton in Texas, attacking James Talarico’s energy policies and promising to scrap methane-emissions limits. The issue also tracks corporate donors courting Democrats and the competitive Senate race in Maine.
cards.durationBasis: Conservative planning allowance; actual duration not independently verified

cards.title: The US in Brief: Here we Comey again
cards.preview: The Justice Department brings another case against James Comey as a court reverses his daughter’s dismissal as a federal prosecutor. The roundup also examines Trump’s election interventions and the tight Senate contest in Alaska.

cards.title: Inside Geopolitics: Should we fear Trump-Putin-Xi collusion?
cards.preview: The panel weighs whether a Trump–Putin–Xi rapprochement could produce deals over the heads of Ukraine, Europe and Taiwan. It distinguishes genuine diplomacy from spheres-of-influence bargaining and asks what leverage smaller powers retain.

cards.title: The US in Brief: Barack Obama v Donald Trump
cards.preview: Obama and Trump take opposing messages to midterm rallies, with Obama challenging divisive attacks on Democratic candidates in Ohio and Michigan. The issue also examines fabricated polling and tight races in Texas.

cards.title: Sexually transmitted infections are surging in Europe
cards.preview: European health authorities report rising syphilis and gonorrhoea despite incomplete testing data. The newsletter weighs possible causes and argues for more testing and less stigma to help curb transmission.
